title: Object Motion Guided Human Motion Synthesis
summary: Two diffusion stages infer hand positions and full-body manipulation from object motion, with hand contact as an intermediate constraint.
limitations: Requires the object trajectory; this is a stronger condition than text and initial state. Single manipulated rigid-object scope.

title: Controllable Human-Object Interaction Synthesis
summary: Joint human/object/contact diffusion combines geometry supervision with contact guidance and connects to planning for extended manipulation.
limitations: Sparse future waypoints are required conditions; guidance is not a force-based execution guarantee.
method: Transformer denoises synchronized human poses, object poses and hand-contact labels; object geometry loss improves waypoint adherence and sampling guidance constrains contacts.
conditions: Language, object BPS geometry, initial human/object state, 2D object positions every 30 frames and final 3D object position.
evaluation: OMOMO manipulation benchmark, unseen-object analysis, motion/contact/waypoint metrics, guidance ablations and scene-planner demonstrations.

title: CG-HOI: Contact-Guided 3D Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Joint diffusion with cross-attention models human motion, object motion and surface contact; predicted contact guides inference.
limitations: Contact-based physical plausibility remains distinct from dynamic simulation; abstract does not establish arbitrary multi-object composition.

title: InterDiff: Generating 3D Human-Object Interactions with Physics-Informed Diffusion
summary: Interaction diffusion forecasts human/object motion and a physics-informed correction predictor refines denoised interactions.
limitations: Future prediction conditioned on observed interaction differs from unconstrained text-to-interaction generation.

title: HIMO: A New Benchmark for Full-Body Human Interacting with Multiple Objects
summary: Provides multi-object captured interaction sequences, whole-sequence and segmented text, plus HIMO-Gen and autoregressive HIMO-SegGen.
limitations: Two/three-object captured setting and explicit segment schedules restrict the demonstrated composition contract.
method: Dual human/object diffusion branches exchange information through mutual interaction; segmented generation conditions later intervals on preceding motion.
conditions: Whole or segmented text prompts, object geometry and initial states; temporal segments supply fine control.
evaluation: HIMO generation, temporal composition and unseen geometry experiments; history-context and model-component ablations.

title: Compositional Human-Scene Interaction Synthesis with Semantic Control
summary: COINS encodes body surface points and objects in a joint latent space, permitting multiple atomic action-object pairs without corresponding composite training examples.
limitations: Primarily interaction pose synthesis; simultaneous semantic composition should not be confused with continuous long-task generation.

title: Stochastic Scene-Aware Motion Prediction
summary: Stochastic scene-aware motion generation combines cluttered navigation and diverse target-object interaction styles.
limitations: Captured sitting/lying/walking/running domain; does not establish dexterous dynamic multi-object manipulation.

title: Synthesizing Diverse Human Motions in 3D Indoor Scenes
summary: DIMOS uses learned motion primitives and scene-aware policies to navigate and perform successive furniture interactions.
limitations: Main interactions are static-scene sitting/lying; RL over motion latents should not be equated to force-based humanoid control.
method: Policies select latent actions of generative motion primitives; navigation uses walkability features and waypoints, interaction uses SDF proximity and marker goals.
conditions: Scene geometry, navigation goals/path waypoints and fine-grained target body markers; interaction goals can be generated by COINS.
evaluation: Locomotion and fine-grained interaction benchmarks, varied object geometry/orientation and body starts, interaction-sequence demonstrations and feature/reward ablations.

title: Diffusion-based Generation, Optimization, and Planning in 3D Scenes
summary: SceneDiffuser combines scene-conditioned diffusion with differentiable optimization and goal-oriented planning across human motion, pose, grasp and navigation tasks.
limitations: Separate task demonstrations do not by themselves prove a unified long-horizon full-body manipulation system.

title: InterGen: Diffusion-based Multi-human Motion Generation under Complex Interactions
summary: Two cooperative weight-sharing denoisers exchange mutual attention to generate coordinated two-person motion from text.
limitations: Demonstrated two-person contract; skeletal relations and proximity losses are not explicit contact dynamics.
method: Shared denoisers, mutual attention, world-frame joint representation and spatial-relation regularization with damping preserve interpersonal coordination.
conditions: Natural-language description; downstream editing/completion variants supply additional motion conditions.
evaluation: InterHuman text-to-interaction benchmark, generation quality/diversity and text alignment comparisons, representation/regularization ablations and editing applications.

title: ReMoS: 3D Motion-Conditioned Reaction Synthesis for Two-Person Interactions
summary: Spatiotemporal cross-attention generates a second person’s body and hand response to a given actor motion; contributes ReMoCap.
limitations: Requires actor motion; reactive completion is a different task from jointly synthesizing both actors from text.

title: FreeMotion: A Unified Framework for Number-free Text-to-Motion Synthesis
summary: Factorizes conditional motion generation into generation and interaction modules to support variable participant counts and spatial controls.
limitations: Number-free formulation does not establish unlimited-scene scalability or collision-free arbitrary crowded interaction.

title: Inter-X: Towards Versatile Human-Human Interaction Analysis
summary: Captured full-body interactions with hand gestures and detailed part-level text support perceptual and generative benchmarking.
limitations: Dataset/benchmark contribution; dataset coverage is not evidence of arbitrary compositional generalization.

title: GOAL: Generating 4D Whole-Body Motion for Hand-Object Grasping
summary: GNet predicts a whole-body goal grasp and MNet produces approach motion with coordinated hands, head and body.
limitations: Near-object starting configuration and grasp endpoint focus; not an extended manipulate-release-navigation system.

title: SAGA: Stochastic Whole-Body Grasping with Contact
summary: Generates whole-body grasping motions using contact as a coordination signal.
limitations: Grasping-specific domain; broader scene-aware long-task composition not established by the checked abstract.

title: IMoS: Intent-Driven Full-Body Motion Synthesis for Human-Object Interactions
summary: Intent-object text encoding and separate variational autoregressors coordinate arms and body for full-body object interaction.
limitations: Intent/action conditioning and near-object motion domain differ from autonomous scene planning.

title: CORE4D: A 4D Human-Object-Human Interaction Dataset for Collaborative Object REarrangement
summary: Combines real collaborative object rearrangement recordings with collaboration retargeting to additional object shapes.
limitations: Synthetic retargeted sequences are not independent real captures; collaborative manipulation differs from unconstrained social interaction.

title: CIRCLE: Capture In Rich Contextual Environments
summary: Captures real human movement in perceived virtual scenes and learns scene-conditioned full-body reaching.
limitations: Reaching and virtual-context collection do not establish contact-force-realistic general manipulation.

title: Scaling Up Dynamic Human-Scene Interaction Modeling
summary: TRUMANS captures human and part-level dynamic-object interaction across indoor scene configurations; autoregressive diffusion supports extended motion synthesis.
limitations: Arbitrary output length is not equivalent to reliable arbitrary task planning or independent physical execution.

title: Revisit Human-Scene Interaction via Space Occupancy
summary: Uses space occupancy to connect locomotion and interaction control; evaluates reaching and extended indoor action sequences.
limitations: Hand-trajectory-controlled manipulation is a stronger contract than text plus initial state; generation metrics do not certify dynamics.

title: InterAct: Advancing Large-Scale Versatile 3D Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Consolidates HOI sources, refines artifacts and hands, augments under contact invariance, and benchmarks six generation/completion tasks.
limitations: Augmentation preserves existing interaction intent and cannot be assumed to add new task semantics; source ancestry matters for evaluation.

title: PAMI: Part Anchored Motion for Text to Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Body-part-relative object votes structure a latent interaction model; coarse generation is followed by contact-oriented surface refinement.
limitations: Reported gains concern InterAct comparison settings; body-part anchoring is not evidence of unrestricted multi-object or articulated planning.

title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling
summary: TRACE retains body, object and hand latent streams while coupling their updates; decoded geometry constrains contacts and completion supports missing streams.
limitations: Cross-stream completion may provide future trajectories of other streams; information contracts must be distinguished from pure text generation.

title: Learning to Generate Human-Human-Object Interactions from Textual Descriptions
summary: Integrates individual HOI and HHI diffusion models through a shared sampling framework to synthesize object-mediated multi-human interactions.
limitations: Composition depends on compatibility of separately trained distributions; abstract alone does not establish persistent scene-state correctness.

title: InteractMove: Text-Controlled Human-Object Interaction Generation in 3D Scenes with Movable Objects
summary: Aligns HOI recordings with scenes containing movable objects and spatial distractors to study text-grounded contextual manipulation.
limitations: Aligned/synthetic scene contexts should be distinguished from newly captured scene-conditioned interaction data.

title: PiGraphs: Learning Interaction Snapshots from Observations
summary: Probabilistic prototype interaction graphs couple body poses, object geometry, contact and visual attention for scene and pose synthesis.
limitations: Static interaction snapshots rather than continuous motion sequences.

title: Human-Object Interaction from Human-Level Instructions
summary: Language planning orchestrates contextual full-body manipulation with finger interactions and RL reference tracking.
limitations: Planner-generated targets and physics tracking are additional system components and conditions; not a single end-to-end text-only generator.

title: PrimHOI: Compositional Human-Object Interaction via Reusable Primitives
summary: Composes relative-geometry interaction primitives spatially and temporally through hierarchical planning, targeting unseen multi-object tasks.
limitations: Reusable primitive planning should be separated from learned unified sequence generation; broad zero-shot claims need the paper-specific task protocol.

title: Surface Keypoint Representation for Multi-Object and Articulated Human-Object Interaction Generation
summary: Represents rigid components with surface-keypoint trajectories, predicts spatiotemporal contact-distance fields and synthesizes contact-guided whole-body motion.
limitations: Three-stage pipeline; point trajectories avoid explicit joint types but do not inherently certify articulation mechanics.

title: DuetHOI: Language-Guided Bimanual Hand--Object Motion Generation with Articulation Planning and Contact Refinement
summary: Contact intent and articulation planning condition structured hand/object generation; proximity refinement fixes objects while correcting hands.
limitations: Hand-centric scope; not whole-body locomotion. v3 replaces earlier StructBiHOI title under the same arXiv identity, so count one paper.

title: COSMI: COmpositional Synthesis of Multi-object Interactions
summary: Composes local contact-consistent captures and trains a variable-object generator grounded in body-part-relative object motion.
limitations: Synthetic dataset hours are not independent captured hours. Semantic/geometric gating is not force-based validation; release availability is separate.
method: Transfer interacting body parts with their objects, use mirrored sources, semantic feasibility and geometric rejection; weight-shared object slots implement variable-count diffusion.
conditions: Text and object conditions; composed sources provide body-part/object relationships for training.
evaluation: Benchmark includes unseen interaction combinations and unseen object; text alignment and contact metrics compare models and dataset transfer.

title: World2HOSI: A Multi-Expert Harness for Long-Horizon Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation
summary: Orchestrates navigation, object and scene interaction experts around persistent scene state, reconciling boundaries and updating object effects.
limitations: Bounded residuals cannot rescue fundamentally infeasible references; reported task success and tracking error are specific to the evaluated system.
method: Structured MotionIR and state updates compile expert conditions; incoming-prefix translation/SO(3) offsets decay with quintic smoothstep. Bounded residual RL tracks references and objects move through simulated contacts.
conditions: Language, reconstructed scene/background and object assets, expert-specific initial/goal/path conditions produced by the harness.
evaluation: Shared tasks versus external systems, user study, fixed-segment boundary ablation, reference-tracking errors and state-dependent multi-stage demonstrations.
